rules: Hatchery or captive rearing alone does not establish aquaculture relevance where the purpose could be stocking, release or sea-ranching. Retain where production/aquaculture use is explicit, or where the study directly evaluates aquaculture operations, inputs, escapes or impacts.

Wild eligible salmonids are relevant where salmon farming/aquaculture is a substantive exposure, pressure, source population, production system or explanatory factor being investigated. Generic implications for future commercial rearing are not sufficient by themselves.

held_for_individual_review.reason: Oregon hatchery steelhead; hatchery purpose is not clear enough from the model rationale to distinguish aquaculture production from stocking/release.
Broad review mixes hatcheries, ocean ranching, net penning and feedlot aquaculture; record-level eligibility depends on how substantive the eligible salmon-aquaculture material is.
The phrase 'wild and/or farming conditions' may indicate substantive farm context, but the model also relies on affiliation; needs direct title/abstract inspection.
